summary: Shows testing a Windows module end to end with a playbook targeting the windows group and an inventory file containing connection variables.
questions: How do I run my new Windows module against a test host?

answer_card.title: Test a Windows module with a playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
Create `hosts` with Windows connection vars and:
```yaml
- name: test out windows module
  hosts: windows
  tasks:
  - name: test out module
    win_module:
      name: test name
```
Run `ansible-playbook -i hosts testmodule.yml`.
